raw.description: 帝皇之戎为团体精灵；战斗开始时，若帝皇之戎为首发精灵，则帝皇之钺担任帝皇之戎的主位，若帝皇之戎所在的位置不为首发精灵，则帝皇之御担任帝皇之戎主位，然后未担任主位的一方担任副位|帝皇之钺担任主位时，自身攻击值提升100点、自身攻击技能先制+1且造成的伤害提升50%；帝皇之钺担任副位时，帝皇之戎每造成300点伤害，回合结束时令对手进入1种非限制类的控制类异常状态|帝皇之御担任主位时，自身速度值提升100点、自身受到攻击伤害后附加伤害值100%的真实伤害；帝皇之御担任副位时，帝皇之戎登场时，解除双方所处的异常状态、2回合内免疫受到的异常状态且所有技能先制+2|自身的副位没有空缺时，自身免疫受到的致命一击伤害且攻击技能无视对手护盾效果并于命中后为对手附加讨，战斗中的星皇之赐、星皇之佑无法指定帝皇之戎以外的精灵为目标，且己方的星皇之佑回合数不会减少、星皇之赐效果翻倍|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]帝皇之戎为[color=#57c975]团体精灵[/color]；战斗开始时，若帝皇之戎为首发精灵，则帝皇之钺担任帝皇之戎的[color=#52a5f2]主位[/color]，若帝皇之戎所在的位置不为首发精灵，则帝皇之御担任帝皇之戎[color=#52a5f2]主位[/color]，[color=#52a5f2]然后[/color]未担任[color=#52a5f2]主位[/color]的一方担任[color=#52a5f2]副位[/color]|[sprite name=dot4]帝皇之钺担任[color=#52a5f2]主位[/color]时，自身攻击值提升100点、自身攻击[color=#52a5f2]技能先制[/color]+1且造成的伤害提升50%；帝皇之钺担任[color=#52a5f2]副位[/color]时，帝皇之戎每造成300点伤害，[color=#57c975]回合结束时[/color]令[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]进入1种非限制类的控制类[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]|[sprite name=dot4]帝皇之御担任[color=#52a5f2]主位[/color]时，自身速度值提升100点、自身受到攻击伤害后附加伤害值100%的[color=#52a5f2]真实伤害[/color]；帝皇之御担任[color=#52a5f2]副位[/color]时，帝皇之戎[color=#57c975]登场时[/color]，解除双方所处的[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]、2回合内[color=#57c975]免疫[/color]受到的[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]且所有[color=#52a5f2]技能先制[/color]+2|[sprite name=dot4]自身的[color=#52a5f2]副位[/color]没有空缺时，自身[color=#57c975]免疫[/color]受到的致命一击伤害且攻击技能无视[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color][color=#57c975]护盾[/color]效果并于命中后为[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]附加[color=#f35555]讨[/color]，战斗中的[color=#f35555]星皇之赐[/color]、[color=#f35555]星皇之佑[/color]无法指定帝皇之戎以外的精灵为目标，且[color=#52a5f2]己方[/color]的[color=#f35555]星皇之佑[/color]回合数不会减少、[color=#f35555]星皇之赐[/color]效果翻倍

review.rationale: 在场主副两份HP/PP、技能互换/死亡继位/主副强化与最后首次增伤已实现，真实入场循环及真实队伍依赖仍延期。
review.singleBehavior: 独立主副HP和PP，初始主钺攻击100、攻击先制1及红伤50%；主御速度100与受攻完整红伤等量真伤；副御入场双方净异与2回免异先制2；副钺每300完整当前伤害结束控制；有副位免暴击伤害、忽盾和攻击命中讨；讨零红伤半最大HP粉伤、连诛当前禁疗及血药例外；已持有星皇赐回复翻倍、佑冻结剩余回合，当前3291目标约束。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实队伍非首发初始化御主位及再次出战历史更新；星皇在真实己方背包中的授予目标与场下来源；讨接收场下队友效果后连诛授予，场下连诛HP真伤与真实切换阶段状态保留。
review.trigger: 真实非首发出场、再登场；出战背包星皇提供命名状态；讨持有者成为场下己方效果目标，连诛持有者位于场下
futureMechanisms: 实际队伍位置与首次/再次出战
真实队伍星皇来源及目标选择
场下效果源与连诛持有者
真正换宠过程中的命名状态与计量保留

additionalSourceEvidence.quote: 自身成为己方场下的精灵的效果目标时，其获得1层连诛
位于场下的自身受到最大体力1/8的真实伤害
自身位于出战背包时，己方精灵拥有星皇之赐

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review

success.name: 4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹
success.assertion: test('4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(event,c){if(event==='beforeBattleStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.a.ailments['烧伤']=4;c.t.ailments['中毒']=4;}old.run(event,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4946/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[20085,10171,29455,29456,38538]});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.amount,2);for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29466,20085);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']>=r,r===3);}});

success.name: 4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零
success.assertion: test('4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149={sourceSide:0};timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(s,38554,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:4500);}const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,hit:false});s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149={sourceSide:0};s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-6;s.fighters[1].effects['物理攻击闪避']={start:1,end:99};turn(s,38554,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);});

success.name: 4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留
success.assertion: test('4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});turn(s,38568,20309);turn(s,38554,20309);const n=sum(s),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.ok(n>=300);assert.equal(st.remainder,n%300);assert.equal(st.pendingControls,0);const statuses=Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments);assert.ok(statuses.length>0);for(const name of statuses)assert.ok(['麻痹','害怕','疲惫','睡眠','石化','冰封','焚烬','诅咒','感染','神游','空定'].includes(name),name);});

success.name: 4950/2149连诛当前在场禁疗沿用户血药例外，独立于技能来源禁疗
success.assertion: test('4950/2149连诛当前在场禁疗沿用户血药例外，独立于技能来源禁疗',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].soulState.lianzhu2149={sourceSide:0};turn(s,29466,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1000);turn(s,29466,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1250);});

success.name: 4950/2149真实团体两套HP和PP，钺初始攻击加100，2581交换到御速度加100并保留旧资源，再交换恢复
success.assertion: test('4950/2149真实团体两套HP和PP，钺初始攻击加100，2581交换到御速度加100并保留旧资源，再交换恢复',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,soul:true,hp:3000}),f=s.fighters[0];f.pp[key(38554)]=1;turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.atk,180);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spe,600);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38554)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.hp,3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(38554)],1);s.fighters[0].hp=5000;turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yue');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38554)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.atk,280);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spe,500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp,5000);});

success.name: 4950/2149主位死亡由真实副位接替，保存0HP与原PP，不进入精灵死亡结算；副位空缺后真正死亡
success.assertion: test('4950/2149主位死亡由真实副位接替，保存0HP与原PP，不进入精灵死亡结算；副位空缺后真正死亡',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});turn(s,29466,10127);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.equal(st.master,'yu');assert.equal(st.reserve,null);assert.equal(st.bodies.yue.hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.finished,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved,undefined);assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),0);s.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(s,29466,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.finished,true);});

success.name: 4950/2149有副位才免受到的致命一击伤害，空缺时真实暴击正常扣血
success.assertion: test('4950/2149有副位才免受到的致命一击伤害，空缺时真实暴击正常扣血',()=>{const values=[];for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,criticals:true});s.fighters[1].effects['必定暴击']={start:1,end:99};if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,29466,10127);values.push(sum(s,'attack',1));}assert.equal(values[0],0);assert.ok(values[1]>0);});

success.name: 4950/2149有副位攻击真实忽略普通盾，副位空缺后盾正常承伤；命中附讨保留命名状态
success.assertion: test('4950/2149有副位攻击真实忽略普通盾，副位空缺后盾正常承伤；命中附讨保留命名状态',()=>{for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=1000;if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,38554,20117);const events=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0);assert.ok(events.length);assert.equal(events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.hpLoss,0)>0,reserve);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149,reserve);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield===1000,reserve);}});

success.name: 4950/2149御主位受攻附加真实伤害等于完整结算红伤，攻击免疫归零不反馈
success.assertion: test('4950/2149御主位受攻附加真实伤害等于完整结算红伤，攻击免疫归零不反馈',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,38568,20309);turn(s,29466,10127);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),sum(s,'attack',1));const x=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true});turn(x,38568,20309);x.fighters[0].effects['攻击伤害免疫']={start:2,end:99};turn(x,29466,10127);assert.equal(sum(x,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(sum(x,'true'),0);});

success.name: 4950/2149消逝移除整个精灵体力上限后不借副位恢复非法正HP，普通主位死亡仍由副位接替
success.assertion: test('4950/2149消逝移除整个精灵体力上限后不借副位恢复非法正HP，普通主位死亡仍由副位接替',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true}),f=s.fighters[0];E.STATUS_RULES.vanish(s,f,1);assert.equal(f.hp,0);assert.equal(f.stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2149].abilities.promote({a:f,t:s.fighters[1],round:1}),false);assert.equal(f.hp,0);assert.equal(f.soulState.vanished,true);});

success.name: 4950/2149钺主位特殊攻击真实提升50%，面板攻击100不混入特攻计算；副位空缺不取消主位增伤
success.assertion: test('4950/2149钺主位特殊攻击真实提升50%，面板攻击100不混入特攻计算；副位空缺不取消主位增伤',()=>{const plain=make({move:38554,index:-1}),normal=[];turn(plain,38554,20309);const base=sum(plain);for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spa,plain.fighters[0].stats.spa);if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,38554,20309);const amount=sum(s);assert.ok(Math.abs(amount-base*1.5)<=1,JSON.stringify({base,amount}));normal.push(amount);}assert.equal(normal[0],normal[1]);});

success.name: 4950/2149已持有星皇之赐有副位时真实回血翻倍至四分之一，无副位恢复八分之一，技能禁疗不封魂印回复
success.assertion: test('4950/2149已持有星皇之赐有副位时真实回血翻倍至四分之一，无副位恢复八分之一，技能禁疗不封魂印回复',()=>{for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000}),f=s.fighters[0];E.SOULS.registry[2149].abilities.grantStar({a:f},f,'gift',meta);if(!reserve){f.soulState.group2149.reserve=null;f.soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}timer(s,0,'技能禁疗',{});turn(s,29466,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,reserve?3250:2125);}});

success.name: 4950/2149已持有星皇之佑有副位不减回合、免异常及免弱，无副位按剩余3回合实际倒计时
success.assertion: test('4950/2149已持有星皇之佑有副位不减回合、免异常及免弱，无副位按剩余3回合实际倒计时',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true}),f=s.fighters[0];const a=E.SOULS.registry[2149].abilities;assert.equal(a.grantStar({a:f},s.fighters[1],'gift',meta),false);assert.equal(a.grantStar({a:f},f,'blessing',meta),true);for(let i=0;i<4;i++)turn(s,29466,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.starBlessing.remaining,3);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[0],'ailmentImmune'),true);s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;for(let i=0;i<3;i++)turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.starBlessing.remaining,0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[0],'ailmentImmune'),false);assert.throws(()=>a.grantStar({a:f},f,'gift',{id:622,hash:'wrong'}),/来源/);});

success.name: 4950/2149目标锁定对真实已部署3291星皇之赐和之佑生效，只拦命名强化，不剥除原魂印固粉及免弱
success.assertion: test('4950/2149目标锁定对真实已部署3291星皇之赐和之佑生效，只拦命名强化，不剥除原魂印固粉及免弱',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/3291.json').snapshot;for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[10499,20530,10047,10539,30381],targetHp:1000});assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'entryAilmentRounds'),0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'pinkImmune'),true);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'weaknessImmune'),true);if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,29466,10499);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,reserve?1000:2125);}});

success.name: 4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数
success.assertion: test('4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数',()=>{for(const entries of [1,2,3,4,5,9]){const s=make({move:38567,index:1,soul:true}),b=make({move:38567,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries=entries;turn(s,38567,20309);turn(b,38567,20309);const boost=Math.max(100,200-(entries-1)*25);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*(1+boost/100))<=2,JSON.stringify({entries,boost,actual:sum(s),base:sum(b)}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,entries);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}const s=make({move:38567,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);});

success.name: 4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰
success.assertion: test('4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰',()=>{for(const mode of ['late','dodge','invalid','immune']){const o={move:38567,soul:true,index:1,enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]},s=make(o),b=make({...o,index:-1});if(mode==='late'){for(const x of [s,b]){turn(x,null,null);turn(x,null,null);}}if(mode==='dodge')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,0,'attackBlock');if(mode==='immune')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);turn(b,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);if(mode==='dodge'){assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*3)<=2);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(b));if(mode==='invalid'||mode==='immune')assert.equal(sum(s),0);if(mode==='immune')assert.ok(s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}});

boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149主位死亡由真实副位接替，保存0HP与原PP，不进入精灵死亡结算；副位空缺后真正死亡',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});turn(s,29466,10127);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.equal(st.master,'yu');assert.equal(st.reserve,null);assert.equal(st.bodies.yue.hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.finished,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved,undefined);assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),0);s.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(s,29466,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.finished,true);});

boundary.name: 4950/2149有副位才免受到的致命一击伤害，空缺时真实暴击正常扣血

boundary.name: 4950/2149已持有星皇之佑有副位不减回合、免异常及免弱，无副位按剩余3回合实际倒计时

boundary.name: 4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数
boundary.assertion: test('4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数',()=>{for(const entries of [1,2,3,4,5,9]){const s=make({move:38567,index:1,soul:true}),b=make({move:38567,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries=entries;turn(s,38567,20309);turn(b,38567,20309);const boost=Math.max(100,200-(entries-1)*25);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*(1+boost/100))<=2,JSON.stringify({entries,boost,actual:sum(s),base:sum(b)}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,entries);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}const s=make({move:38567,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);});

boundary.name: 4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰
boundary.assertion: test('4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰',()=>{for(const mode of ['late','dodge','invalid','immune']){const o={move:38567,soul:true,index:1,enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]},s=make(o),b=make({...o,index:-1});if(mode==='late'){for(const x of [s,b]){turn(x,null,null);turn(x,null,null);}}if(mode==='dodge')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,0,'attackBlock');if(mode==='immune')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);turn(b,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);if(mode==='dodge'){assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*3)<=2);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(b));if(mode==='invalid'||mode==='immune')assert.equal(sum(s),0);if(mode==='immune')assert.ok(s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}});

interaction.name: 4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹

interaction.assertion: test('4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});turn(s,38568,20309);turn(s,38554,20309);const n=sum(s),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.ok(n>=300);assert.equal(st.remainder,n%300);assert.equal(st.pendingControls,0);const statuses=Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments);assert.ok(statuses.length>0);for(const name of statuses)assert.ok(['麻痹','害怕','疲惫','睡眠','石化','冰封','焚烬','诅咒','感染','神游','空定'].includes(name),name);});

interaction.assertion: test('4950/2149钺主位特殊攻击真实提升50%，面板攻击100不混入特攻计算；副位空缺不取消主位增伤',()=>{const plain=make({move:38554,index:-1}),normal=[];turn(plain,38554,20309);const base=sum(plain);for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spa,plain.fighters[0].stats.spa);if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,38554,20309);const amount=sum(s);assert.ok(Math.abs(amount-base*1.5)<=1,JSON.stringify({base,amount}));normal.push(amount);}assert.equal(normal[0],normal[1]);});

interaction.name: 4950/2149已持有星皇之赐有副位时真实回血翻倍至四分之一，无副位恢复八分之一，技能禁疗不封魂印回复
interaction.assertion: test('4950/2149已持有星皇之赐有副位时真实回血翻倍至四分之一，无副位恢复八分之一，技能禁疗不封魂印回复',()=>{for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000}),f=s.fighters[0];E.SOULS.registry[2149].abilities.grantStar({a:f},f,'gift',meta);if(!reserve){f.soulState.group2149.reserve=null;f.soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}timer(s,0,'技能禁疗',{});turn(s,29466,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,reserve?3250:2125);}});

interaction.name: 4950/2149已持有星皇之佑有副位不减回合、免异常及免弱，无副位按剩余3回合实际倒计时
interaction.assertion: test('4950/2149已持有星皇之佑有副位不减回合、免异常及免弱，无副位按剩余3回合实际倒计时',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true}),f=s.fighters[0];const a=E.SOULS.registry[2149].abilities;assert.equal(a.grantStar({a:f},s.fighters[1],'gift',meta),false);assert.equal(a.grantStar({a:f},f,'blessing',meta),true);for(let i=0;i<4;i++)turn(s,29466,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.starBlessing.remaining,3);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[0],'ailmentImmune'),true);s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;for(let i=0;i<3;i++)turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.starBlessing.remaining,0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[0],'ailmentImmune'),false);assert.throws(()=>a.grantStar({a:f},f,'gift',{id:622,hash:'wrong'}),/来源/);});

interaction.name: 4950/2149目标锁定对真实已部署3291星皇之赐和之佑生效，只拦命名强化，不剥除原魂印固粉及免弱
interaction.assertion: test('4950/2149目标锁定对真实已部署3291星皇之赐和之佑生效，只拦命名强化，不剥除原魂印固粉及免弱',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/3291.json').snapshot;for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[10499,20530,10047,10539,30381],targetHp:1000});assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'entryAilmentRounds'),0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'pinkImmune'),true);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'weaknessImmune'),true);if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,29466,10499);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,reserve?1000:2125);}});

interaction.name: 4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数
interaction.assertion: test('4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数',()=>{for(const entries of [1,2,3,4,5,9]){const s=make({move:38567,index:1,soul:true}),b=make({move:38567,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries=entries;turn(s,38567,20309);turn(b,38567,20309);const boost=Math.max(100,200-(entries-1)*25);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*(1+boost/100))<=2,JSON.stringify({entries,boost,actual:sum(s),base:sum(b)}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,entries);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}const s=make({move:38567,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);});

interaction.name: 4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰
interaction.assertion: test('4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰',()=>{for(const mode of ['late','dodge','invalid','immune']){const o={move:38567,soul:true,index:1,enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]},s=make(o),b=make({...o,index:-1});if(mode==='late'){for(const x of [s,b]){turn(x,null,null);turn(x,null,null);}}if(mode==='dodge')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,0,'attackBlock');if(mode==='immune')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);turn(b,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);if(mode==='dodge'){assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*3)<=2);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(b));if(mode==='invalid'||mode==='immune')assert.equal(sum(s),0);if(mode==='immune')assert.ok(s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}});

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.assertion: test('4950/1616实际克制时取得本系加成、非克制不额外加成；979两组下轮先制按真实参数且清除失败不授',()=>{for(const type of['水','普通']){const values=[];for(const index of[-1,0]){const s=make({move:38554,index});s.fighters[1].type=type;turn(s,38554,20309);values.push(sum(s));}assert.equal(values[1]>values[0],type==='水');}for(const [move,turns,amount]of[[38554,1,3],[38557,2,2]]){const s=make({move,index:1});turn(s,move,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.end,1+turns);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.amount,amount);const x=make({move,index:1});timer(x,1,'protect',{});turn(x,move,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].effects.id984,undefined);}});

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP
success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});

success.assertion: test('4950/2588首次先手200增伤真实执行，2589御主位本招零红，钺主位按实际红伤恢复',()=>{const s=make({move:38567,index:1,soul:true});turn(s,38567,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);const x=make({move:38567,index:4,soul:true});turn(x,38568,20309);turn(x,38567,20309);assert.equal(sum(x),0);const y=make({move:38567,index:4,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(y,38567,20309);assert.ok(sum(y)>0);assert.equal(y.fighters[0].hp-1000,sum(y));});

success.name: 4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数
success.assertion: test('4950已答2588首次先手增伤200即三倍红伤，出战2至5次每次少25直到100下限，初始真实主副交换不增加出战次数',()=>{for(const entries of [1,2,3,4,5,9]){const s=make({move:38567,index:1,soul:true}),b=make({move:38567,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries=entries;turn(s,38567,20309);turn(b,38567,20309);const boost=Math.max(100,200-(entries-1)*25);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*(1+boost/100))<=2,JSON.stringify({entries,boost,actual:sum(s),base:sum(b)}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,entries);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}const s=make({move:38567,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);});

success.name: 4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰
success.assertion: test('4950已答2588仅实际先手增伤，后手不增、无效与免红不造伤害，原生必中不受闪避干扰',()=>{for(const mode of ['late','dodge','invalid','immune']){const o={move:38567,soul:true,index:1,enemyLoadout:[37920,20117,10127,20309,37911]},s=make(o),b=make({...o,index:-1});if(mode==='late'){for(const x of [s,b]){turn(x,null,null);turn(x,null,null);}}if(mode==='dodge')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,0,'attackBlock');if(mode==='immune')for(const x of [s,b])timer(x,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);turn(b,38567,mode==='late'?37920:20309);if(mode==='dodge'){assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*3)<=2);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(b));if(mode==='invalid'||mode==='immune')assert.equal(sum(s),0);if(mode==='immune')assert.ok(s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38567)],4);}});

instance.description: 后出手时下回合攻击技能先制+3

raw.description: 若自身处于能力下降状态则技能先制+3；先出手时造成的攻击伤害提升200%，自身每出战1次，效果减少25%，最低100%；后出手时下回合攻击技能先制+3；反转自身能力下降状态，反转成功则对手臣服；帝皇之钺担任主位时造成的伤害额外恢复至自身体力，帝皇之御担任主位时此技能无法造成伤害；击败对手时，若己方没有瀚宇星皇，则将瀚宇星皇作为额外精灵加入到己方的出战背包中

success.assertion: test('4950全部18招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生团体全部首轮含2588先手并独立承担主副PP',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.entries,1);if(m.fifth){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);if(!m.fifth){const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}}});
